title: Microsoft Purview: connector that brings ChatGPT Enterprise prompts and responses into Purview
summary: The briefing passes: the connector prerequisites, collection controls, permissions and consumption billing are supported by Microsoft documentation. Minor corrections should clarify the collection wizard's remaining settings and the preview cmdlet's limited availability.

claims.claim: Scans are created through Sources > registered workspace > New scan.

claims.quote: If you're using the classic experience, open the classic Microsoft Purview governance portal, go to Data Map, Sources, and select Register.

claims.claim: The collection-policy wizard is reached through Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Classifiers > Collection policies > + Create policy.
claims.quote: Open the Data loss prevention solution and navigate to Classifiers > Collection policies. Select + Create policy.
claims.fix: Keep the documented route into the wizard. Append to controls[1].note: 'Configure user/group scope and content capture in the wizard; content capture requires Content contains classifiers set to All.' The current route stops before those settings.

claims.claim: New-FeatureConfiguration -Name "<policy name>" -FeatureScenario KnowYourData -Mode Enable -ScenarioConfig '<JSON>' creates an enabled collection policy with the supplied configuration.
claims.quote: New-FeatureConfiguration -Name "Collection policy for supported Copilots" -FeatureScenario KnowYourData -Mode Enable -ScenarioConfig '{"Activities":["UploadText","DownloadText"],"EnforcementPlanes":["CopilotExperiences","Browser"],"SensitiveTypeIds":["All"],"IsIngestionEnabled":true}'

claims.claim: IsIngestionEnabled in ScenarioConfig governs AI content capture.
claims.quote: "IsIngestionEnabled":true ... This example creates an enabled collection policy ... Captures all AI prompts.

claims.claim: New-FeatureConfiguration is in Public Preview.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is currently available in Public Preview, isn't available in all organizations, and is subject to change.
claims.fix: Replace 'Cmdlet is in Public Preview' in controls[1].note with 'Cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell, is in Public Preview, and is not available in all organizations.'

claims.claim: For new customers rather than classic Azure Purview customers, Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Account details starts linking billing to an Azure subscription and resource group.
claims.quote: Select Get Started in the ribbon menu to start the process. This can also be done from Settings > Account details. ... Select your active Azure subscription from the list. ... Select the resource group.

claims.claim: Existing classic Azure Purview customers consent to pay-as-you-go through Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Account overview > Review Consent.
claims.quote: Open the Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Account overview in the new Microsoft Purview portal. Select Review Consent and switch to the pay-as-you-go model.

claims.claim: Only a Global Administrator can consent to switching to Purview pay-as-you-go billing.
claims.quote: Only an account in the Global Administrator role can provide consent to switch to the pay-as-you-go model.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation to enable or consent to this Purview pay-as-you-go subscription linkage was found.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Purview enable pay as you go billing Azure subscription PowerShell REST API consent FeatureConfiguration; Purview pay-as-you-go enable billing consent REST API PowerShell. Opened both payg enablement guides and billing models; no equivalent call found.

claims.claim: Collection policy content capture can capture and store detected prompts and responses from Enterprise AI data sources.
claims.quote: you can decide whether to capture and store all detected prompts and responses from any generative AI data sources you add to the policy. ... only applies to the following data sources: - Copilot experiences - Enterprise AI

claims.claim: Content capture requires the Content contains classifiers condition to be set to All.
claims.quote: To capture AI content, you must set the Content contains classifiers condition to All.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > DSPM for AI (classic) > Recommendations > Secure interactions from enterprise apps creates a one-click policy capturing enterprise AI prompts and responses.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > DSPM for AI (classic) ... From DSPM for AI (classic) > Recommendations page ... select Secure interactions from enterprise apps, which creates a one-click policy to capture prompts and responses from enterprise AI apps.

claims.claim: The retention policy location for ChatGPT Enterprise interactions is Enterprise AI apps.
claims.quote: For retention policies, select the option for Enterprise AI apps.

claims.claim: Microsoft's getting-started guidance says to wait at least a day for data before reviewing reports.
claims.quote: Wait at least a day for data, and then navigate to the Reports page to view the results of your policy.

claims.claim: The subscription-based enablement route applies to organizations that are not current classic Azure Purview pricing customers.
claims.quote: Applies to: - Organizations that aren't current Azure Purview customers using the classic data governance pricing model customers.

claims.claim: The consent route applies to existing Azure Purview customers using the classic data governance pricing model.
claims.quote: Applies to: - Existing Azure Purview customers who are using the classic data governance pricing model.

claims.claim: Only a Global Administrator can enable Purview pay-as-you-go through the new-customer route.
claims.quote: Only an account in the Global Administrator role can enable the pay-as-you-go model
